product.name: ECMS Mobile
product.description: Mobile app for English-center students and teachers
product.platform: Expo / React Native, also previewed on web

redesignGoal: Redesign the existing mobile app for clear, touch-friendly student and teacher workflows while preserving current features, API behavior, and demo-mode profile selection.
constraints: Keep all user-facing content in Vietnamese.
Design mobile-first for narrow phone screens, with a usable tablet and web preview layout.
Preserve both Student and Teacher modes and the ability to switch between them.
There is currently no login flow. Users choose a sample student or teacher profile for local testing.
Show clear loading, empty, error, success, and pending-approval states.
Do not imply that real money is charged: payment is a demo and staff confirmation is required.

interaction: bottom sheets or dialogs for focused tasks

content: API connection error panel when requests fail
globalShell.navigation: Fixed bottom tab bar; show five mode-specific tabs and a clear active state.
globalShell.demoProfileSelection: Student mode selects a student profile in the Personal tab. Teacher mode selects a teacher profile near the top of the teacher workspace.
